steps.content: A hundred years into the Nightfall, humanity endures in the choking shadow of Mania, clawing its way back toward civilization, step by painstaking step.

So too this great city-state, drowned in ruin time after time, yet still it stands. Steeped in despair past counting, yet destruction never arrived. In time, the people have come to believe that DisCity is blessed, that DisCity is a land of hope, and that DisCity will never fall.
But only because fools remain blind to the designs of fate.

BR-001 Ruins Isolation Belt, The Rust
BR-002 Mine, West District
BR-004 Ruins Isolation Belt, Old Keylan Square
BR-005 Ruins Testing Site, WhiteSands

steps.speaker: FAC
steps.content: We've got M-value anomalies across BR-001, 002, 004, and 005, all happening at once. Every site's reporting signs of Underground activity.

steps.speaker: 9th
steps.content: Footage analysis confirms it's all autonomous combat puppets. No humans on-site, or rather, no intelligent entities. They're just running on preset sorcery.

steps.speaker: FAC
steps.content: We can handle them. The puppets lack a clear offensive objective. It's likely just a recon sweep, maybe a diversion, or some kind of scheduled response drill that's part of a longer game.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Got it.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Contain the contamination and minimize casualties. Focus on the civilians. Keep them isolated, and keep them safe.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: The West District mine got the warning early. They've evacuated all personnel, and they even came forward with proposals for intelligence and security cooperation. Samuel and Matilda have submitted patrol and tracking plans for the Underground scouts.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Everyone's heard how much you've thrown yourself into this. They're worried you're pushing too hard. They all want to help, to do their part, Chief.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I know. Thank them for me.
Years of deep collaboration with every department have honed your instincts. A disruption like this can hardly stir a ripple now. You're more than ready for this.
Now, you just need to—
A phantom image cuts through your vision, gone in a blink. Dizziness washes over you, and your hand finds your temple before thought catches up.
...Not again...

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: ...Chief, are you alright?
The sound of Hecate's familiar voice jolts you back to your senses.
You draw yourself upright, your voice regaining its composure, knowing that your next words will ring clear across every battlefield, heard by all.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: All four sites, stand ready for engagement. And make sure the Ring Research Institute is notified. Tell them not to lower their guard. We all know what's happening on the surface is just a diversion.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Our enemy's real target is <color=#fb9259>BR-003</color>.
